title: A Deterministic $0.401$-Approximation for Non-monotone Submodular Maximization under Matroid Constraints
summary: Submodular maximization arises in a wide range of combinatorial optimization problems and has been extensively studied from the perspective of approximation algorithms. For maximizing nonnegative, non-monotone submodular functions subject to a matroid constraint, randomized algorithms achieve a $0.401$-approximation, whereas obtaining comparable deterministic guarantees remains challenging. In this paper, we present a deterministic $0.401$-approximation algorithm in the exact value and independence oracle model, improving upon the previous deterministic guarantee of $(0.385-\varepsilon)$…
